title: Introducing the 2026 Rizzardi IN SIX Yacht
description: Discover the 2026 Rizzardi IN SIX Yacht—a luxurious 71-foot yacht blending unmatched speed, customizable design, and cutting-edge performance.
html:
The 2026 Rizzardi IN SIX is a 71-foot masterpiece that redefines the standards of modern yachting. Built with a focus on challenging the limits, this yacht offers a harmonious blend of speed and sophistication. Its sleek design is matched by its ability to deliver exceptional performance, making it a standout choice for those who appreciate both aesthetics and functionality.

Unmatched Speed and Performance Features

At the heart of the Rizzardi IN SIX is its impressive performance capability. With a cruising speed of 44 knots and the potential to reach up to 50 knots, this yacht is engineered for those who value speed. The IN SIX is equipped with a powerful 2,600 horsepower engine, ensuring that it not only meets but exceeds expectations in terms of velocity and power on the water.

Innovative Design and Customization Options

The IN SIX offers over 120 customizable options, allowing owners to tailor the yacht to their specific preferences. This level of personalization ensures that each vessel is unique, reflecting the individual style and requirements of its owner. The design emphasizes a seamless integration of form and function, providing a vessel that is as visually striking as it is practical.

Luxurious Interior and Open Layout Design

The layout of the IN SIX is designed to maximize both space and comfort. Featuring a large open hard-top leading to a glass door, the yacht creates a continuous flow between the external and internal environments. This open layout enhances the sense of space and provides a versatile area for relaxation and entertainment, making it ideal for both social gatherings and private retreats.

Advanced Engine and Transmission Systems

The technical prowess of the IN SIX is evident in its advanced engine and transmission systems. Owners have the choice between twin MAN 1,200hp or 1,550hp diesel engines, both paired with the innovative Top System surface transmissions. Supported by the Easy-trim system and joystick control, these features ensure not only high-speed performance but also exceptional handling at lower speeds, offering a smooth and responsive experience.

The Pinnacle of Modern Yacht Engineering

The 2026 Rizzardi IN SIX represents the pinnacle of modern yacht engineering, combining speed, design, and innovation in a single vessel. Its customizable features, open layout, and advanced technical systems make it a compelling choice for those who seek a yacht that can deliver both performance and style.
